si4_title: Normative Modeling of Brain Morphometry in Clinical High Risk for Psychosis

dc1_datasets_using.detail: The study uses the pooled dataset from the ENIGMA Clinical High Risk for Psychosis Working Group and normative models from CentileBrain, which were constructed using an independent multisite sample from the ENIGMA Lifespan Group.
dc1_datasets_using.supporting_text: The study sample was derived from the pooled dataset of individuals with CHR-P and healthy individuals held by the ENIGMA Clinical High Risk for Psychosis Working Group... the normative models for each regional measure in the framework were developed using data from an independent multisite sample of 37 407 healthy individuals... from the ENIGMA Lifespan Group.
dc1_datasets_using.location: Haas2024.pdf.md: Methods / Study Sample; Haas2024.pdf.md: Methods / Normative Modeling of Brain Morphometry

answer.ENIGMA-CHR-P: evaluation of normative deviations in CHR-P and site-matched healthy controls

dc2_datasets_purpose.detail: CentileBrain (37,407 HC) was used for the construction of normative models. The ENIGMA CHR-P sample (1,340 CHR-P and 1,237 HC) was used as the application and evaluation sample to test clinical associations of normative deviations.
dc2_datasets_purpose.supporting_text: the normative models... were developed using data from an independent multisite sample of 37 407 healthy individuals... The model parameters in the normative framework (CentileBrain) were then applied to each regional... measure of the individuals with CHR-P and healthy individuals in the ENIGMA sample.
dc2_datasets_purpose.location: Haas2024.pdf.md: Methods / Normative Modeling of Brain Morphometry; Haas2024.pdf.md: Computing Deviation Scores of Regional Morphometric Measures

dc3_hc_number.detail: The normative models were constructed using 37,407 healthy individuals. The development involved an 80/20 split for training and internal testing, resulting in approximately 29,926 individuals for the training phase (80% of 37,407).
dc3_hc_number.supporting_text: developed using data from an independent multisite sample of 37 407 healthy individuals... Sex-specific subsamples of each pooled sample were randomly split into a training subset (80%) and a test subset (20%)
dc3_hc_number.location: yoi230077supp1_prod_1703694733.69427.pdf.md: eMethods / Normative modeling using FreeSurfer-derived regional brain morphometric measures

dc4_age_info.detail: The overall age range for the CentileBrain normative sample is 3-90 years. Mean and SD for the normative construction sample were not explicitly reported in the manuscript. Training phase statistics are inferred to follow the overall range due to the stratified splitting procedure.
dc4_age_info.location: Haas2024.pdf.md: Methods / Normative Modeling of Brain Morphometry

dc5_sex_info.detail: The overall normative sample (N=37,407) was 53.3% female (n=19,938). Male N is calculated as 17,469 (46.7%). Training phase numbers are estimated based on the 80% split (15,950 female, 13,975 male).
